name: Lacustrine-Hypostyle
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near an orbital debris ring.
The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Debris from the starship crash site (warship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
